headline: Agenda lists items on a DPW funding request, BPRW playground renovation, White Cane Awareness Day, and PlanBTV 2050 wishlist.
summary: Items include adopting the agenda and minutes, a public forum, and committee updates. This is an agenda, not minutes, so it does not show how any item was decided.
